biggest_catch: Up to $600 in three $200 tiers: $200 for $1,000+ ACH direct deposits in two full calendar months (easy); two more $200 tiers require maintaining a $10,000+ average monthly balance across Verve deposit accounts for 3 and 12 months (real money to park).
catches: New members only: no Verve Checking or Membership Share account within the past 18 months.
Must purchase and maintain one $5.00 par-value share in a savings account.
$200 Welcome: qualifying ACH DDs totaling $1,000+ within the first two full calendar months after opening; paid within 30 days after qualification period.
$200 Three-Month Balance: average monthly balance of $10,000+ across qualifying deposit accounts (checking, savings, MM, certificates, IRAs, HSAs) for the first three full calendar months.
$200 Twelve-Month Balance: average monthly balance of $10,000+ across qualifying accounts through 12 full calendar months.
Checking account must be open and in good standing at each payout; paid within 30 days after each qualification period.
Bonus reported as interest on IRS 1099-INT.
Offer valid for accounts opened July 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026; subject to modification or discontinuation.

steps: Open a new Verve checking account between July 1 and December 31, 2026 as a new member (no Verve checking/share in the past 18 months) and fund the $5 membership share.
Within the first two full calendar months, receive qualifying ACH direct deposits totaling $1,000+ into the new checking account (earns $200).

Optionally maintain an average monthly balance of $10,000+ across qualifying Verve deposit accounts for the first three full calendar months (+$200) and through the first 12 full calendar months (+$200).
timing: Each tier paid within 30 days after the end of its qualification period; 12-month balance tier requires the full year.
